generic_source.name: Axeyum.Autogenesis.gcdDivisibilityFamilyGenericV1
parameters: gcdZeroLeft : forall n, gcd 0 n = n
gcdSucc : forall m n, gcd (succ m) n = gcd (mod n (succ m)) (succ m)
modQuotientWitness : forall m n, 0 < m -> exists q, m*q + mod n m = n
dvdRefl : forall n, n divides n
dvdMulRight : forall d a b, d divides a -> d divides a*b
dvdAdd : forall d a b, d divides a -> d divides b -> d divides a+b
dvdAddCancel : forall d a b, d divides a -> d divides a+b -> d divides b
generic_source.conclusion: the conjunction of (forall m n, gcd m n divides m and gcd m n divides n) and (forall d m n, d divides m -> d divides n -> d divides gcd m n)
generic_source.method: two Nat.gcd.induction proofs; the common-divisor pair reconstructs n from quotient plus remainder, while the greatest-common-divisor direction cancels the quotient product from that same equation
